description: This file defines GUI components for icon selection and display in a menu editor application, including classes for icon entry, file dialogs, and icon tree views.

classes.name: IconEntry
classes.description: A custom GTK menu button widget for selecting and displaying icons, with support for browsing icon themes and files, and emitting value change signals.

classes.name: IconFileSelectionDialog
classes.description: A GTK file chooser dialog for selecting image files, filtered to image MIME types.

classes.name: IconSelectionDialog
classes.description: A GTK dialog for searching and selecting icons from the icon theme, with a tree view and search functionality.

classes.name: IconSelectionTreeView
classes.description: A GTK tree view listing available icons from the theme, supporting filtering and selection.

methods.name: _on_browse_icons_clicked
methods.description: Handles the event when the user clicks to browse icons, opens icon selection dialog.

methods.name: _on_browse_files_clicked
methods.description: Handles the event when the user clicks to browse files, opens file selection dialog.

methods.name: _set_image
methods.description: Sets the icon image based on the icon name or file, handling theme icons and files.

methods.name: _on_successful_image
methods.description: Updates UI and internal state when an icon image is successfully loaded.

methods.name: _on_error_image
methods.description: Updates UI and internal state when an icon image fails to load.

methods.name: set_icon
methods.description: Sets the icon in the icon selection tree view.

methods.name: get_icon
methods.description: Retrieves the currently selected icon from the tree view.

methods.name: _on_search_changed
methods.description: Filters the icon list based on search input.

methods.name: _on_treeview_row_activated
methods.description: Handles double-click or Enter key activation on an icon, confirming selection.

methods.name: _on_key_press_event
methods.description: Handles key events for the icon selection dialog, e.g., Ctrl+F to focus search.

methods.name: _get_path_to_icon
methods.description: Finds the tree path for a given icon name.

methods.name: refilter
methods.description: Refilters the icon list based on current search query.
